title: managedidentity
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, keyvaultreferenceid, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, ownerid, owningbusinessunit, owningteam, owninguser.

clientsecret.description: Contains a secret for the Azure Active Directory application.

createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

credentialsource.description: Where the Managed Identity will get the credentials to use.

identitytype.description: Determines Identity type for Managed Identity

importsequencenumber.description: Sequence number of the import that created this record.

ismanaged.description: Indicates whether the solution component is part of a managed solution.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was modified.

name.description: The name assigned to this Managed Identity.

overriddencreatedon.description: Date and time that the record was migrated.

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the Managed Identity

subjectscope.description: Where the Scope of the SubjectName for Managed Identity will be determined.

tenantid.description: The Id of the Azure Active Directory Tenant that the Application is part of.

utcconversiontimezonecode.description: Time zone code that was in use when the record was created.

version.description: Version indicating the format of the FIC subject.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the record.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the record.

_keyvaultreferenceid_value.description: Unique identifier for keyvaultreference which contains the secret.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who modified the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the record.

_owningbusinessunit_value.description: Unique identifier for the business unit that owns the record

_owningteam_value.description: Unique identifier for the team that owns the record.

_owninguser_value.description: Unique identifier for the user that owns the record.
